guardedSupplyChest.name: War Supply Chest
guardedSupplyChest.description: (Guarded; after winning, choose either 8 resources or +2 to one primary skill)
guardedSupplyChest.onGuardedMessage:
{War Supply Chest}

A heavy chest, guarded by a mixed army of creatures from many lands. Will you attack them?
guardedSupplyChest.onSelectMessage:
{War Supply Chest}

The guards have scattered. The chest holds a load of supplies and a few books of war and magic, but you can take only one.

guardedScrollChest.name: Arcane Scroll Chest
guardedScrollChest.description: (Guarded; after winning, get a spell scroll based on hero level, or burn it for Spell Points)
guardedScrollChest.onGuardedMessage:
{Arcane Scroll Chest}

A chest holding a sealed spell scroll, guarded by a mixed army of creatures from many lands. Will you attack them?
guardedScrollChest.onSelectMessage:
{Arcane Scroll Chest}

The guards have scattered. Inside the chest is a sealed spell scroll. You can keep the scroll, or burn it on the spot and absorb its magic into your Spell Points.
